paragraphs: The project documents safeguards against vulnerable group exclusion. The immediate benefit is climate resilience: flood-ready border posts. If reliable services reach affected traders, they could support livelihoods; effectiveness remains unverified.
Traders and communities near cancelled DRC sites may lose access to benefits, and the documents do not say how.
